name: wailing_caverns-extra
status: draft (the Disciple of Naralex event of Wailing Caverns, written offline from script_waypoint 3678 and the escort script, machine-checked, never walked and never run live; it needs a GM commander for the return (gm_cross) or a live-probed non-GM return hop, and is not exported to the run leader; not for running before that)
notes: Naralex event: needs a GM commander for the return (gm_cross), OR a live-probed non-GM return hop: the navmesh on map 43 has two disconnected parts and the only join is the one-way Serpentis-foot jump, probed partial in both directions; the reverse hop (ramp lip -287.5 5 -63.6 down to the foot -293.3 0.5 -58) is untested live; the Naralex event is meant to run as its own segment starting at the Disciple. This file is that segment: its legs are the former legs 12-20 of dungeons/wailing_caverns.json, which was cut back to the mapped walk to Verdan (legs 0-11, exported to the TortoiseBots run leader) so that no run of the base plan needs a GM; the gm_cross of the return_gossip leg stays only here. The plan-export tool refuses this file (the steps below are not run leader steps); the file is loaded and checked by the dungeon tests (shape, steps, waits, follow stretches, navmesh) so that it cannot rot.

The Disciple of Naralex event of Wailing Caverns, as plan legs (the gossip at menu 202 option 0, the escort's stops of script_waypoint 3678, the summoned waves, Mutanus held by instance data 4 reading DONE). Mapped offline (world database export of map 43, src/scripts/dungeons/wailing_caverns/wailing_caverns.cpp and instance_wailing_caverns.cpp, script_waypoint 3678, gossip_menu 201/202); not walked live.

WHEN: after the four Fanglords (3671, 3669, 3670, 3673; Verdan and Skum are not needed) are dead. instance_wailing_caverns.cpp then sets the Disciple's default gossip menu to 202 and he yells (YELL_AFTER_GOSSIP). Before that his menu is 201 (text 698, gossip script 201 casts Mark of the Wild 5232 on the player). WHERE: the Disciple of Naralex (3678, faction 35, npc_flags 1, level 20, 1429 hp) stands at -134.965 125.402 -78.0945, 24 yd from the entrance point. The way back from Verdan is the long one: the hop of dungeons/wailing_caverns.json taken the other way (its landing -287.5 5.0 -63.6 up to the foot -293.3 0.5 -58.0) cannot be climbed (the probe of 2026-10-18, tests/wc-hop-probe-2: a move from the ramp back to the foot stopped 5.0 yd short), and the navmesh of map 43 has two parts with the one-way jump as the only join (a plan from Verdan's room to the Disciple's stand is partial: the nearest reachable point is 81 yd short; the reverse is partial too), so the return of the first leg, return_gossip, is a gm_cross waypoint at the Disciple's stand, where a GM moves the party from behind Verdan (the commander's own character `.go xyz -131 127 -78.6`, `.bot summon <lead bot>`, `cmd summon` the others). The alternatives are the game's own shortcut, the waterfall hole behind Verdan (a drop into the river near the entrance, and the walk from the river), or a live-probed hop from the ramp lip down to the foot followed by the 1713 yd walk to the Disciple (an open follow-up: a live probe of the Serpentis return hop with move_hop_exact). The leg's target is the stand of the gossip (-134 128.5), not the Disciple's spawn point.

ESCORT RULE (core ScriptedEscortAI.cpp lines 226-234 and 303-312): while the Disciple is out of combat the escort FAILS when every member of the group is more than 100 yd from him. A walking NPC is slower than bots, so the follow legs stop at points of his road no more than 80 yd apart in a straight line (the stretch from one stop to the next, the stand counting as the first stop) and every stop waits for the Disciple seen within 8 to 9 yd of it before the party goes on: the party is then at most 80 + 9 yd ahead of him. A test pins the longest stretch and the vias of each follow leg to 80 yd.

STEP 2, the escort (31 script_waypoints, 3678 walks at speed_walk 1 and is attacked by what is summoned; if he dies his summons vanish (JustDied) and the escort is over; the script does not say whether it can be started again; Wowhead says it cannot until the instance resets and the four Fanglords are killed again): the party must stay with him and kill what comes. Stops: waypoint 0 at his spot (he says SAY_CAST_MARK and casts Mark of the Wild 5232 on every living player within 30 yd, 5 s); waypoint 7 (-102.4 232.8 -91.5): two Deviate Ravagers (3636, 'raptors') are summoned at -67.9 214.4 -93.5 and -69.8 211.3 -93.5 and run at him, then he talks 5 s; waypoint 15 (-54 276.2 -92.8): Serpentine Cleansing (6270, a 15 s cast, he is rooted and does not react to attacks while it runs) and three Deviate Vipers (5755) summoned at -52.9 269.8, -58.5 279.8 and -49.6 278.2 (z -92.8) after the cast; waypoint 26 (52.2 208.7 -89.5): a 3 s stop, SAY_BEFORE_CHAMBER; waypoint 30 (114.6 236.9 -96.0, facing Naralex 3679 at 115.4 240.0 -94.0): the ritual. He casts Sleep (1090) on one of his attackers every 30 s and drinks a potion (8141) below 80 percent hp.

STEP 3, the ritual at waypoint 30 (timers from the script, in seconds after he arrives): +1 SAY_BEFORE_RITUAL, +3 Naralex's Awakening 6271 (the Disciple is stunned by his own spell), +7 Naralex's emote, +12 three Deviate Moccasins (5762, level 20-21) summoned at Position[7..9] (123.8 271.9, 151.9 234.3, 127.6 200.8; z about -102), +52 seven Nightmare Ectoplasm (5763, level 20-21, faction 14, mechanic_immune_mask 64, immune to roots) at Position[3..9] (142.7 254.0, 140.5 219.8, 92.2 261.9, 100.3 268.6, 123.8 271.9, 151.9 234.3, 127.6 200.8), +92 Naralex speaks again, +102 Mutanus the Devourer (3654, level 22, 7944 hp, faction 270, EventAI 1720974-6) is summoned at Position[3] = 142.7 254.0 -102.2. Mutanus's spells: Naralex's Nightmare 7967 (interruptible), Terrify 7399, Thundercrack 8150; he has a school immunity mask of 32 (shadow). The summoned creatures run to the Disciple and attack him when they have no victim: the tank holds them, the others stay near him. When Mutanus dies (TYPE_MUTANUS DONE) every hostile of the instance that is alive or has no loot is despawned, and the script sets TYPE_DISCIPLE DONE: Naralex wakes, they speak (about 20 s) and fly away along 5 points, despawning (respawn 12 h). The loot (Mutanus drops the Glowing Shard, which starts a quest) stays on his corpse.

WOWHEAD (read with tools/wowhead/wh.py: the strategy guide 7843, the npc pages of Mutanus 3654 and the Disciple 3678 and their comments; data, the script wins): the escort is optional and unlocks when all four Fanglords are dead; protect the Disciple at all costs, if he dies or the group wipes the event fails and cannot be repeated until the instance resets; Mutanus is a group-composition check: Thundercrack (8150) hits everything near him hard (melee suffer, bring ranged and a second healer for it), Terrify (7399), and Naralex's Nightmare (7967, a shadow sleep: 'makes others evil and asleep', interruptible, see the tactics of the boss) are his spells; Mutanus is immune to shadow damage (a comment; his school_immune_mask 32 agrees); fight the waves with area damage (Arcane Explosion, totems, Frost Nova and Polymorph for the swarm) and keep the AoE damage dealers alive; clear the mobs on the way to Naralex's room beforehand; a comment counts five Nightmare Ectoplasm where the script summons seven, another that killing the slimes too fast can keep Mutanus from spawning (the script has a plain timer) and another that killing the waves too fast stalls Naralex's spell animation on a later realm, so let the Disciple be hit first: unverified. His loot includes the Glowing Shard, which starts a quest.

WHAT THE DRIVER CANNOT DO YET: (1) there is no step that walks WITH the escort NPC: the follow legs walk ahead to each of his stops and wait_for.unit pins the party there until he arrives (state seen, radius 8 to 9 yd round the stop), which is an approximation, not a walk at his side; (2) nothing waits for a summon inside a leg: the wave pulls sit in the legs after the waits, so a wave the script summons late is pulled only when its own leg's pull runs (the ritual waves ride the waits of the legs before); the wave waits use the state `dead`, which passes on a corpse in view or a kill the run saw, because the summons despawn when they die and a `gone` wait (which needs a living unit seen first) could never pass after the pull has run; (3) summoned waves (the vipers, Moccasins, ectoplasm and Mutanus have no spawn rows) are modelled as pull groups and waits at the summon positions: the driver fights what the feed shows there; (4) the Disciple must live: no step marks an NPC as one to protect (the waits' fail_texts are the only witness); (5) a boss with several possible spawn spots (Lady Anacondra) and a way down by falling (the shortcut behind Verdan) have no step either, see the main plan.

From the verdan leg's end the walk back over the ramp and the hop is impossible (the hop cannot be climbed, live 2026-10-18, tests/wc-hop-probe-2), and the waterfall hole behind Verdan is a fall, not a step: this leg starts with a gm_cross to the entrance hall, where a GM moves the party (the commander's own character `.go xyz -131 127 -78.6`, `.bot summon <lead bot>`, `cmd summon` the others; remote runs with a GM commander; the module's own run leader has no such move, so this plan is not exported; the navmesh has no walk from Verdan's room to the Disciple, see the plan notes). The leg's target is the stand of the gossip (-134 128.5 -78.1), 3.9 yd from the gm_cross point, not the Disciple's spawn point. The Disciple of Naralex (3678, spawn guid 18675, -134.965 125.402 -78.0945, faction 35) stands 5.4 yd from the gm_cross point, 24 yd from the entrance. The wait checks he is alive at his stand, then the tank takes option 0 of his menu 202 ('Let the event begin!', gossip_menu_option 202/0, action script 202 = command 85 Start Escort; instance_wailing_caverns.cpp sets the menu only when Anacondra, Cobrahn, Pythas and Serpentis are DONE): the escort starts and the Disciple casts Mark of the Wild 5232 on every living player within 30 yd (5 s) and walks. He is then attackable by the event's summons only: never pulled by the party, skip.

His spells are Naralex's Nightmare 7967 (a shadow sleep, interruptible), Terrify 7399 and Thundercrack 8150 (Thundercrack hits everything near him: keep the ranged and the healer off his feet); his school_immune_mask 32 says shadow immunity (a Wowhead comment agrees). NO boss tactics: ai_boss_tactic has no rows for him (map 43 has only Zandara Windhoof 61968). The boss's hold is the event's own gate: the party stands at the ritual stop (114.6 236.9 -96, the hold's spot, radius 50: the whole chamber between the summon points and the pool) and fights what the event sends until instance data 4 (TYPE_DISCIPLE) reads 3 (DONE) - which the script sets only when TYPE_MUTANUS (instance data 5) reads DONE, from Mutanus's own EventAI (1720976: command 37 on death, datalong 5, datalong2 3; 1720975 on aggro sets it 1 in progress; 1720974 on evade back to 0). 600 s is the hold's ceiling: the summons end 102 s after the Disciple's arrival, the fight a few minutes more. When Mutanus dies every hostile the script knows is despawned (instance_wailing_caverns.cpp SetData TYPE_MUTANUS DONE), Naralex wakes (he sits, SAY_NARALEX_AWAKEN), the two speak about 20 s and fly away along the script's fly points (MovementInform 33-38, 12 h respawn); the Glowing Shard (the quest item Mutanus drops, unverified live) stays with his corpse and is not in the plan.
